questions.question: Which fruit has the most vitamin C?
questions.explanation: Guava has 4 times more Vitamin C than an orange — it's a superfruit! 🍈

questions.question: What vegetable can you see in the dark after eating?
questions.explanation: Carrots are rich in Vitamin A which helps your eyesight — especially night vision! 🥕

questions.question: Which food gives you the most energy?
questions.explanation: Carbohydrates like rice, bread and pasta are your body's main energy fuel! 🍚

questions.question: What is the world's most popular fruit?
questions.explanation: Technically tomatoes are fruits — and they're the most eaten 'fruit' worldwide! 🍅

questions.question: Which nut is actually a legume?
questions.explanation: Peanuts grow underground and are legumes like beans and lentils, not true nuts! 🥜

questions.question: How much water should you drink per day?
questions.explanation: About 8 glasses (2 litres) of water a day keeps your body working perfectly! 💧

questions.question: Which Indian dish is made from fermented rice and lentils?
questions.explanation: Dosa batter is fermented overnight — that's why it's crispy and slightly tangy! 🫓
